reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already covers missing, numeric and ranged amounts.

duplication.why: No amount logic is re-written; the mapping is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts and the list handler type in api-handlers.ts, where the API shapes live.

scope.why: A read-only list type, one mapping line, the handler signature, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A separate APIScheduleListEntity keeps the read-only field out of the create/update input type, and the value follows any change to the shared amount rule.
